paragraphs.text:
“You are mad!” your guide cries. She raises her weapon, watching 
you with dangerous eyes. “Stay then! And die.”

She backs off toward the river. You give her a few minutes 
and then follow. If you still had a serviceable canoe, it has gone 
with her.
If you have not already, record the keyword BAREFOOT. Go to 56.
